summary: 法律渗透日常生活，也成为社会评价行为的重要尺度。文章说明律师如何解释规则、参与法律发展，并从专业工作的实际内容和公众对法律的理解，解释律师评价为何两极分化。
logic: 日常生活处处涉及法律

sentences: The law influences all of us virtually all the time.
法律几乎一直影响着我们所有人。
It governs almost all aspects of our behaviour, and even what happens to us when we are no longer alive.
它几乎制约着我们行为的方方面面，甚至制约着我们不再活着时发生的事情。
It affects us from the embryo onwards.
它从胚胎开始就影响我们
It governs the air we breathe, the food and drink we consume, our travel, family relationships, and our property.
它控制着我们呼吸的空气，我们消费的食物和饮料，我们的旅行，家庭关系，以及我们的财产。
It applies at the bottom of the ocean and in space.
它适用于海底和空间。

Each time we examine a label on a food product, engage in work as an employee or employer, travel on the roads, go to school to learn or to teach, stay in a hotel, borrow a library book, create or dissolve a commercial company, play sports, or engage the services of someone for anything from plumbing a sink to planning a city, we are in the world of law.
每次我们检查食品标签、从事雇员或雇主工作、在公路上旅行、上学或教书、住在旅馆、借阅图书馆书籍、创建或解散商业公司、玩体育、或为从水槽管道到规划城市等任何事项雇用他人服务时，我们都是法律界人士。

paragraphs.brief: 公众影响法律的能力日益增强。
sentences: Law has also become much more widely recognised as the standard by which behaviour needs to be judged.
法律还被广泛承认为需要判断行为的标准。
A very telling development in recent history is the way in which the idea of law has permeated all parts of social life.
法律思想渗透到社会生活的所有部分，这是近代史上一个非常有意义的发展。
The universal standard of whether something is socially tolerated is progressively becoming whether it is legal, rather than something that has always been considered acceptable.
社会是否容忍某事的普遍标准正在逐渐成为合法标准，而不是被视为可被接受的标准。
In earlier times, most people were illiterate.
在早期，大多数人是文盲。
Today, by contrast, a vast number of people can read, and it is becoming easier for people to take an interest in law, and for the general population to help actually shape the law in many countries.
相比之下，今天，许多人能够阅读，人们对法律感兴趣，大众实际上帮助许多国家制定法律，这变得越来越容易。
However, law is a versatile instrument that can be used equally well for the improvement or the degradation of humanity.
然而，法律是一种多用途工具，同样可以很好地用于改善或降低人类地位。
This, of course, puts law in a very significant position.
这当然使法律处于非常重要的地位。
In our rapidly developing world, all sorts of skills and knowledge are valuable.
在我们迅速发展的世界中，各种技能和知识都是宝贵的。
Those people, for example, with knowledge of computers, the internet, and communications technology are relied upon by the rest of us.
例如，那些掌握计算机、互联网和通信技术的人，是我们其他人所依赖的。
There is now someone with IT skills or an IT help desk in every UK school, every company, every hospital, every local and central government office.
现在，在联合王国的每所学校、每家公司、每所医院、每所地方和中央政府办公室，都有一位具有信息技术技能的人或一个信息技术服务台。
Without their knowledge, many parts of commercial and social life today would seize up in minutes.
没有他们的知识，今天商业和社会生活的许多部分将在几分钟内就占上风。
But legal understanding is just as vital and as universally needed.
但是，法律理解同样重要，也是普遍需要的。

The American comedian Jerry Seinfeld put it like this, ‘We are all throwing the dice, playing the game, moving our pieces around the board, but if there is a problem, the lawyer is the only person who has read the inside of the top of the box.’
美国喜剧演员Jerry Seinfeld这样说，“我们都在扔骰子，玩游戏，在板上摆动我们的碎片，但如果有问题，律师是唯一读过盒子顶部的人。”
In other words, the lawyer is the only person who has read and made sense of the rules.
换句话说，律师是唯一能阅读和理解规则的人。
The number of laws has never been greater.
法律数量从未超过此数。
In the UK alone, about 35 new Acts of Parliament are produced every year, thereby delivering thousands of new rules.
仅在联合王国，每年就有大约35项新的议会法案，从而产生了数千项新规则。
The legislative output of the British Parliament has more than doubled in recent times from 1,100 pages a year in the early 1970s, to over 2,500 pages a year today.
英国议会的立法产量近期已翻了一番，从20世纪70年代初每年1100页增加到现在每年超过2500页。
Between 1997 and 2006, the legislature passed 365 Acts of Parliament and more than 32,000 legally binding statutory instruments.
在1997年至2006年间，立法机关通过了365项议会法案和超过32,000项具有法律约束力的法定文件。

In a system with so much law, lawyers do a great deal not just to vindicate the rights of citizens and organisations but also to help develop the law through legal arguments, some of which are adapted by judges to become laws.
在法律如此多的制度中，律师不仅为维护公民和组织的权利做了大量工作，而且还通过法律论据帮助制定法律，其中有一些由法官调整后成为法律。
Law courts can and do produce new law and revise old law, but they do so having heard the arguments of lawyers.
法律法院可以而且确实制定了新的法律，并修订了旧的法律，但是他们听取了律师的论点。

paragraphs.brief: 人们对律师的负面观感。
sentences: However, despite their important role in developing the rules, lawyers are not universally admired.
然而，尽管律师在制定规则方面发挥着重要作用，但他们并没有受到普遍尊重。
Anti-lawyer jokes have a long history going back to the ancient Greeks.
反律师的笑话有很长的历史追溯到古希腊人

More recently, the son of a famous Hollywood actor was asked at his junior school what his father did for a living, to which he replied, ‘My daddy is a movie actor, and sometimes he plays the good guy, and sometimes, he plays the lawyer.’
最近，一个著名的好莱坞演员的儿子在他的小学校被问及他的父亲是做什么的，他回答说，“我爸爸是一名电影演员，有时他扮演好人，有时他担任律师。”

For balance, though, it is worth remembering that there are and have been many heroic and revered lawyers such as the Roman philosopher and politician Cicero, and Mahatma Gandhi, the Indian campaigner for Independence.
但是，为了平衡起见，值得记住的是，有并曾经有许多英勇和受尊敬的律师，如罗马哲学家和政治家西塞罗，还有印度争取独立运动者圣雄甘地。

paragraphs.brief: 批评律师为何有欠公平。
sentences: People sometimes make comments that characterise lawyers as professionals whose concerns put personal reward above truth, or who gain financially from misfortune.
人们有时发表一些意见，认为律师是专业人员，其关切是个人报酬高于事实，或从不幸中获取金钱。
There are undoubtedly lawyers that would fit that bill, just as there are some scientists, journalists and others in that category.
毫无疑问，有些律师符合该法案，正如有些科学家、记者和其他这类人一样。
But, in general, it is no more just to say that lawyers are bad because they make a living from people’s problems than it is to make the same accusation in respect of nurses or IT consultants.
但一般而言，仅仅说律师是坏人，因为他们靠人的问题谋生，就不如对护士或信息技术顾问提出同样的指控。
A great many lawyers are involved in public law work, such as that involving civil liberties, housing and other issues.
许多律师参与公法工作，例如涉及公民自由、住房和其他问题的工作。
Such work is not lavishly remunerated and the quality of the service provided by these lawyers relies on considerable professional dedication.
此类工作的报酬不高，这些律师所提供的服务的质量取决于相当专业的奉献。
Moreover, much legal work has nothing to do with conflict or misfortune, but is primarily concerned with drafting documents.
此外，许多法律工作与冲突或不幸无关，但主要涉及起草文件。
Another source of social disaffection for lawyers, and disaffection for the law, is a limited public understanding of how law works and how it could be changed.
对律师的社会不满和对法律的不满的另一个根源是公众对法律如何运作和如何改变法律的认识有限。
Greater clarity about these issues, maybe as a result of better public relations, would reduce many aspects of public dissatisfaction with the law.
这些问题的更明确性，也许由于公共关系改善，将减少公众对法律的许多不满。

items.zh: 为 A 段选择最能概括全段的标题。
items.answer: iv · The law applies throughout our lives
items.cue: 法律几乎一直影响着我们所有人。
items.why: 从胚胎阶段到呼吸、饮食和购物，普通人处处都会与法律发生联系。

items.zh: 为 B 段选择最能概括全段的标题。
items.answer: vii · The public’s increasing ability to influence the law
items.solution: 公众影响法律的能力日益增强
items.cue: 然而，法律是一种多用途工具，同样可以很好地用于改善或降低人类地位。
items.why: 从昔日多数人不识字写到今日许多人能阅读、参与及推动法律事务。

items.zh: 为 C 段选择最能概括全段的标题。
items.answer: i · Different areas of professional expertise
items.cue: 这当然使法律处于非常重要的地位。
items.why: 以计算机专家的不可或缺作类比，说明法律专长也支撑商业和社会活动。

items.zh: 为 D 段选择最能概括全段的标题。
items.cue: 法律法院可以而且确实制定了新的法律，并修订了旧的法律，但是他们听取了律师的论点。
items.why: 英国议会通过法案的统计和法院创设新规则的作用，共同说明法律越来越多。

items.zh: 为 E 段选择最能概括全段的标题。
items.answer: vi · A negative regard for lawyers
items.solution: 人们对律师的负面观感
items.cue: 然而，尽管律师在制定规则方面发挥着重要作用，但他们并没有受到普遍尊重。
items.why: 流传已久的挖苦和笑话都是例子，段落关注律师如何被公众看待。

items.zh: 为 F 段选择最能概括全段的标题。
items.answer: ii · Reasons why it is unfair to criticise lawyers
items.solution: 批评律师为何有欠公平
items.cue: 对律师的社会不满和对法律的不满的另一个根源是公众对法律如何运作和如何改变法律的认识有限。
items.why: 不能因部分律师牟利就概括整个职业，作者举低报酬的公益法律工作等反例。

options: 以计算机专家的不可或缺作类比，说明法律专长也支撑商业和社会活动。
Reasons why it is unfair to criticise lawyers
批评律师为何有欠公平
不能因部分律师牟利就概括整个职业，作者举低报酬的公益法律工作等反例。
The disadvantages of the legal system
文章提到公众不满，也讨论法律的力量，但没有专段列出制度自身的缺陷。
The law applies throughout our lives
从胚胎阶段到呼吸、饮食和购物，普通人处处都会与法律发生联系。
The law has affected historical events
法律曾影响重大历史事件
早今对比说明公众参与能力的改变，文章没有追述法律如何扭转具体历史事件。
人们对律师的负面观感
流传已久的挖苦和笑话都是例子，段落关注律师如何被公众看待。
The public’s increasing ability to influence the law
公众影响法律的能力日益增强
从昔日多数人不识字写到今日许多人能阅读、参与及推动法律事务。
英国议会通过法案的统计和法院创设新规则的作用，共同说明法律越来越多。

items.en: Which TWO of the following statements does the writer make about legal skills in today’s world?
items.zh: 作者在当今世界上对法律技能的以下两个说法是什么呢？
correct: Knowledge of the law is as important as having computer skills.
了解法律与掌握计算机技能同样重要。
Society could not function effectively without legal experts.
没有法律专家，社会就无法有效运作。

items.en: Lawyers as professionals People sometimes say that ________ is of little interest to lawyers, who are more concerned with making money.
items.zh: 有人说，律师对________兴趣不大，赚钱才是他们更关心的事。
items.why: 题干“is of little interest to lawyers”对应原文“把个人回报置于真理/真实之上”。

items.en: This may well be the case with some individuals, in the same way that some ________ or scientific experts may also be driven purely by financial greed.
items.zh: 个别人或许确实如此，正如一些________或科学专家也可能只受金钱利益驱使。
items.why: 回到对应内容“毫无疑问，有些律师符合该法案，正如有些科学家、记者和其他这类人一样”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: However, criticising lawyers because their work is concerned with people’s problems would be similar to attacking IT staff or ________ for the same reason.
items.zh: 但如果因为律师处理人们遇到的难题就批评他们，那同样也可以用这个理由去指责信息技术人员或________。
items.why: 类比“指责律师=指责IT人员或护士”。

items.en: In fact, many lawyers focus on questions relating, for example, to housing or civil liberties, which requires them to have ________ to their work.
items.zh: 许多律师关注的是住房或公民自由等问题，要做好这些工作就必须对工作有________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“此类工作的报酬不高，这些律师所提供的服务的质量取决于相当专业的奉献”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: What’s more, a lot of lawyers’ time is spent writing ________ rather than dealing with people’s misfortunes.
items.zh: 而且，律师有很大一部分时间花在撰写________上，直接处理他人不幸遭遇的时间并没有那么多。
items.why: 律师大量时间用于撰写文件。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 题干说更在乎赚钱，原文说把个人报酬放在事实之上。
题目把这种做法称为批评律师，原文以“说律师不好”复述这一指责。
points: 以计算机专家的不可或缺作类比，说明法律专长也支撑商业和社会活动。
题干“is of little interest to lawyers”对应原文“把个人回报置于真理/真实之上”。
clauses: A very telling development in recent history is the way ….
“in which the idea of law has permeated all parts of social life”修饰前面的 way。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 way，再把修饰信息接回主句。
The universal standard of whether something is socially tolerated is progressively becoming ….
“whether it is legal, rather than something that has always been considered acceptable”补足 becoming 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 becoming 所在的主句，再把 whether 后面的内容作为一个整体。
